answer: At the inlet mouth, I embed a sable umber dye packet whose seal must echo in a fleet-wharf sonar pulse within 0.9ms; any unmatched packet expiry drains 0.0015 ℓη̄ of the identity’s stake per ms of drift. Sybils ship extra packets from offshore farms, yet each new packet stretches arrival time by 0.9ms, compounding ℓη̄ loss linearly and revealing farms that can’t feed dye in parallel.
